sections.heading: From blank repo to live threads
sections.text: From blank repo to live threads Install, connect, hooks, live messages — loops below and pauses when you scroll away. STEP 1 Install One dependency. No native binaries, no sidecar. $ pnpm add @fluxy-chat/sdk STEP 2 Point at your edge Worker URL + scoped JWT — the client never sees admin keys. baseUrl: "https://chat…" token: "eyJ…" STEP 3 Open a room Hooks subscribe, send, and reconcile — you keep your UI primitives. useChat({ roomId, client }) LIVE Ship the inbox Typing, delivery, and history — already moving on the wire. Hey — is the edge worker up? Yes. Messages are live.
